secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Resend email API key (https://resend.com/api-keys). Optional — email notifications are silently skipped if not set, so the app boots and works without it.

secrets.name: SENDER_EMAIL
secrets.description: Verified sender address for Resend (e.g. noreply@yourdomain.com). Optional — only needed together with RESEND_API_KEY to enable email notifications.
